steps.name: seed
steps.file:
# my Grok Build config
model = "grok-4.7"

# my own hooks
[[hooks.Stop]]
  [[hooks.Stop.hooks]]
  type = "command"
  command = "say done"

[[hooks.Stop]]
  [[hooks.Stop.hooks]]
  type = "command"
  command = "say again"

[[hooks.PostToolUse]]
matcher = "run_terminal_command"
  [[hooks.PostToolUse.hooks]]
  type = "command"
  command = "my-log"
